name: section-label
title: SectionLabel
description: Small uppercase muted label that names a block: a section heading ("Endpoints", "1 · Operation"), a field label ("Mock URL") or a list header ("3 operations"). Used on Service, Copilot, Behavior, TestCreate, TestRun, Traces, Usage and more.

a11y.pattern: A class on the right native element: <h2>-<h6> for a section heading, <label for> for a field, <span> for a plain caption
aria: The text is written in its normal case: text-transform only changes the look, so screen readers do not spell it letter by letter
As a heading it keeps the page outline: pick the level from the page, not from the size
a11y.notes: Muted text on the canvas, surface and raised backgrounds stays at 4.5:1 in both themes. Static item: not focusable. The lineHeight option (data-line-height normal | snug) only changes the line box, not the semantics.
